solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Approval follows to be on wrong computer

indicators.note: follows places the word for approval after the rearranged letters
wrong tells us the letters of to be on are set out incorrectly, so they must be reordered

parts.note: OK is a nod of approval

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles that a signed-off decision depends on being on the wrong computer.
explanation.definitionFit: A laptop-style portable machine is commonly called by this name, so it is an example of a computer.

clue.text: Work it out before you leave

definitions.text: Work it out before you leave

parts.words: Work it out before you leave
parts.note: an employee who resigns must serve, or work out, a fixed warning period before departing; 'work it out' looks like 'solve it'

explanation.surface: Advice to solve a puzzle before heading off.
explanation.definitionFit: The warning period given before quitting a job is something staff work out before they go.

clue.text: Inflammation of a certain spot? It can't be helped

definitions.meaning: medical inflammations end in -itis, so a whimsical inflammation of 'there' (a certain spot) is ...
a resigned shrug of a phrase meaning that's how things are

explanation.surface: A doctor diagnoses a sore spot and shrugs that nothing can be done.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a stock expression of resignation, and joking -itis endings make it a mock illness of a place.

clue.text: Almost naked diver: trouble when one goes up

indicators.note: almost means the word for naked stops short of its final letter

parts.note: bald means bare or naked
a loon is the North American name for the diving bird called a diver

explanation.surface: A nearly unclothed diver gets into difficulty as he rises.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom 'when the balloon goes up' means when the trouble starts.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: when the balloon goes up, a crisis breaks, so the object is what rises at the start of trouble.

clue.text: Small group of commandos taking enemy territory at the front

indicators.note: at the front tells us to take the leading letter of each of the five words that precede it

explanation.surface: A small commando squad seizes hostile ground in the front line.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of eight musicians or things is a small ensemble or group.

clue.text: Cocktail from small island in the endless sea?

indicators.note: in places the island inside the shortened word for sea
endless means the word for sea loses its last letter

parts.note: the main is a poetic term for the open sea
an ait is a small river island, especially in the Thames

explanation.surface: A drink served on a little island out in the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: A rum-based tiki drink of Polynesian style is a well-known cocktail.

clue.text: Sort of bridge needing care: lower maximum speed a bit

indicators.note: lower tells us to shift the speed letter further down the word, which reads downwards in this clue
a bit says the shift is small, only one place

parts.note: caution means care
c is the physics symbol for the speed of light, the maximum possible speed

explanation.surface: Instructions for a careful driver approaching a bridge to cut speed slightly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bridge' suggests a road structure, but it is the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: A version of the card game in which tricks bid and won are scored is one sort of bridge.

clue.text: Subject of article staff found inadequate

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: inadequate means the word for staff falls short by its last letter

parts.note: men can mean the staff or workforce

explanation.surface: An article reports that the employees were found wanting.
explanation.definitionFit: The topic of a talk or essay is its subject, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Extremely popular tools

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
spades are digging tools

explanation.surface: A shop's best-selling garden tools are very much in demand.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in large amounts or to a great degree, so it stands for extremely.

clue.text: Elegant clothes worn by student for light reading

parts.note: chic means stylish or elegant

indicators.note: worn by places the student inside the word for clothes, as if the clothes wrap round him

parts.note: kit is clothing or gear
L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: A student dressed in smart clothes is doing some easy reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Popular fiction about young women's lives is a genre of light reading.

clue.text: Picks tenth hotel on tour: it gets complicated

indicators.note: on tour suggests the letters travelling about, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A travel company chooses a tenth hotel for a tour, making arrangements harder.
explanation.definitionFit: This stock phrase is said when a story or situation becomes more intricate.

clue.text: One smoked in bed: it takes a brave man to intervene

indicators.note: to intervene means the brave man goes between the letters of the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a hero is a brave man

explanation.surface: Someone smoking in bed needs a courageous rescuer to step in.
explanation.definitionFit: A cigar with both ends cut square is a thing that is smoked.

clue.text: Fancy our cousin is out of power a long time

indicators.note: out of means the power letter is taken away

parts.note: a chimp is a close relative, a cousin, of humans
P is the symbol for power in physics
an era is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone suggests that a relative of ours has long been out of office.
explanation.definitionFit: A fanciful notion or wild illusion; fancy here is a noun meaning imagined idea.

clue.text: Writer in Belgian port, not O Henry

indicators.note: not tells us to remove the O from the port's name

parts.note: Ostend is a port on the Belgian coast
Hal is a short form of Henry, as Shakespeare's Prince Hal

explanation.surface: An author living in a Belgian port is not the American story-writer O. Henry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'O Henry' looks like the American author O. Henry, but it splits into O to remove and Henry for HAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The French novelist who wrote Le Rouge et le Noir is a famous writer.

clue.text: Service chief set over the main body

indicators.note: set over places the first piece above the second in this down answer

parts.note: high means chief, as in high priest
the mass is the bulk or main body of something

explanation.surface: A chief is placed in charge of most of the organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: A solemn Eucharist with full ceremony and music is a church service.

clue.text: Northern river covered in top-quality shellfish

indicators.note: covered in puts the river letter inside the word for top-quality

parts.note: ace means first-rate

explanation.surface: A northern river is full of excellent shellfish.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: this is mother-of-pearl, the lining of shellfish, rather than the creatures themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Mother-of-pearl, the iridescent shell lining, is shellfish material taken loosely for the shellfish.

clue.text: Female composer failing to start composed with help

parts.note: a cow is a female of cattle and other animals

indicators.note: failing to start means the composer's name loses its first letter

parts.note: Benjamin Britten was an English composer

explanation.surface: A woman composer, who could not begin, completed a piece with assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece written jointly with someone else was composed with that partner's help.

clue.text: Horse in box, one going to bolt

parts.note: a chest is a large box
a nut is screwed on to a bolt

explanation.surface: A horse in its stall is about to run off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bolt' suggests a horse running away; it is the threaded metal fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish-brown horse is called by this colour name, so it is a kind of horse.

clue.text: Prophet's house on the shore?

indicators.note: on places the house letters first, as a house on the seafront

parts.note: the shore stands loosely for the sea, the seaside

explanation.surface: A prophet lives in a seaside house.
explanation.definitionFit: He is one of the minor prophets of the Old Testament, with a book named after him.

clue.text: With immediate effect, a low temperature brings round precipitation

indicators.note: brings round means the precipitation word is wrapped round the temperature

parts.note: snow is a form of precipitation
zero degrees Fahrenheit, written O F, is a low temperature

explanation.surface: A sudden cold snap brings snow straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means starting from this moment, i.e. with immediate effect.

clue.text: Act enthusiastically, but not be in Hamlet?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for doing something with great energy and lavishness
someone setting off for a larger settlement is leaving the hamlet behind

explanation.surface: An actor overacts wildly but is not cast in Shakespeare's play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hamlet' looks like the play, but it is a small village.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to throw oneself into something with gusto, and literally means heading for a larger place.

clue.text: Plant finally sent soldiers sword

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of sent

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is a British army corps of soldiers
a foil is a fencing sword

explanation.surface: A plant has at last dispatched soldiers with a sword.
explanation.definitionFit: Clover and its relatives with three-part leaves are plants of this name.

clue.text: Complete one set of books? One of them incomplete

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books

indicators.note: incomplete means the book's name loses its last letter

parts.note: Acts is one of the New Testament books

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether one set of books is full when one volume is missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something whole and undamaged is complete, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Space to turn around in ship's cabin?

definitions.meaning: the open water a ship needs to manoeuvre without hitting anything
whimsically, a room at sea, i.e. a cabin aboard ship

explanation.surface: A cramped ship's cabin has barely enough space to turn round.
explanation.definitionFit: A nautical term for clear water allowing a vessel to manoeuvre, read jokingly as a room at sea.

clue.text: Player's agent clearing fine

indicators.note: clearing means the fine letter is removed from the agent word

parts.note: a factor is an agent who acts for another
F is the pencil-grading abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A sportsman's agent pays off a fine on his behalf.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer on stage plays a part, so is a player.

clue.text: In bent condition, force chapter out of reference book

parts.note: F is the symbol for force in physics

indicators.note: out of means the chapter letter is taken away

parts.note: a lexicon is a dictionary, a reference book

explanation.surface: Someone forces a chapter out of a dictionary, leaving it bent.
explanation.definitionFit: The anatomical term for bending a joint describes a bent condition.

clue.text: Female relative almost has a wild life

indicators.note: almost means the relative word stops short of its last letter

parts.note: an aunt is a relative

explanation.surface: A female relative nearly leads a wild existence.
explanation.definitionFit: The animals of a region collectively are its wildlife, written here as two words.

clue.text: Absolutely no refreshment with son coming in? That's distasteful

indicators.note: coming in places the son letter inside the joined phrase

parts.note: not one means absolutely none
a cup of tea is a refreshment

explanation.surface: A host refuses any drink when the son arrives, finding the visit unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom says something is not to one's liking, which is what distasteful conveys.

clue.text: From top seat heard this cast

indicators.note: heard says the seat word is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: a throne is the seat at the top, the royal chair

explanation.surface: A spectator hears this troupe from the best seat in the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cast' looks like actors, but it is the past participle of throw.
explanation.definitionFit: Cast as a past participle means flung or tossed, a straight synonym.

clue.text: During delay not important to return books stored here perhaps

indicators.note: during puts the reversed word inside the delay word

parts.note: a wait is a delay

indicators.note: to return means the word for not important is read backwards

parts.note: null means void or of no importance

explanation.surface: While waiting, someone decides returning library books is not important.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of furniture fixed to the wall with shelves is one place books may be kept.
